Package com.example.cosmos_discovery.database

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
com.example.cosmos_discovery.database.NotificationService
public class NotificationService extends Object
Firestore-backed access layer for the per-user notification feed.

Each user has a users/{uid}/notifications subcollection containing one document per notification. This service exposes async write/delete/listen operations and a backfill helper for the audience field added in a later schema version.

Async methods take onSuccess / onError callbacks rather than returning values. Real-time listeners return a ListenerRegistration which the caller MUST remove in onDestroyView() or onStop() to avoid leaks.

    • writeNotificationToUsers

      public void writeNotificationToUsers(List<String> userIds, Notification notif, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onError)
      Writes the same notification to multiple users atomically via WriteBatch. Safe for lists up to 500 users (Firestore batch limit).

    • writeNotificationToUsers

      public void writeNotificationToUsers(List<String> userIds, String docId, Notification notif, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onError)
      Same as above but uses a fixed docId for each user's notification document, so repeated calls overwrite the previous notification instead of appending a new one. Pass null for docId to use an auto-generated ID.

    • deleteNotification

      public void deleteNotification(String userId, String notifId, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onError)

    • deleteAllNotifications

      public void deleteAllNotifications(String userId, List<Notification> notifications, Runnable onSuccess, Consumer<String> onError)
      Batch-deletes all supplied notification documents for the given user. Uses WriteBatch so all deletes are atomic (safe for up to 500 items).

    • listenNotifications

      public com.google.firebase.firestore.ListenerRegistration listenNotifications(String userId, Consumer<List<Notification>> onUpdate, Consumer<String> onError)
      Returns a real-time listener on the user's notifications subcollection, ordered newest-first. Caller must call remove() in onDestroyView().

    • backfillAudience

      public void backfillAudience(String userId, List<Notification> notifications)
      Stamps the audience field on any legacy notification docs missing it. Inferred from the notification type. Safe to call repeatedly — only writes docs that lack the field.
